name: stiff_colebrook_friction
source:
{ The Colebrook-White implicit friction factor: f appears inside a logarithm and
  under a square root on both sides. From the standard guess this needs several
  step-halved Newton iterations, and the derivative d/df of 1/sqrt(f) blows up as
  f -> 0, so the step control is load-bearing. }
GUESS f = 0.02
Re = 1.5e5
eps_D = 0.0002
1 / sqrt(f) = -2 * log10(eps_D / 3.7 + 2.51 / (Re * sqrt(f)))
dP = f * 50 * 998 * 2 ^ 2 / (2 * 0.05)
